== Published Flagship image versions ==
Four distinct PC image versions were checked in Holotable history: 2018-07-08, 2023-03-31, 2023-06-18 and 2026-07-29. The March 2023 image drops “your” before Alter; June restores it; July 2026 changes the loss timing phrase. Each image and game-text crop is linked from its article. The older Decipher Glossary article keeps its own words and a matching credited HiRez recreation. The historical PC image articles do not claim unimplemented GEMP IDs. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

The shared [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|official PDF]], cover dated text as of June 1, 2017, prints this partial on page 8. Full sources are first located in repository records dated 8 July 2018, 31 March 2023, 18 June 2023, 29 July 2026. These records do not establish original first publication days. Descending moves preserve article/Talk histories and existing source assets. Bare current gameplay <code>4_122</code> follows image 5, matching the current constructor/configured face; no historical executable ID is invented. == Uncovered original fields beneath the June 2017 cutout ==
The source cover directs placing the lower cutout in a sleeve with the original physical card. Its replacement begins at the type band, below the original title, destiny and lore. The original [[:File:Dagobah-D-flagship-decipher-archive.gif]] supplies the still-uncovered destiny 3 and literal lore; later full PC faces are not the source of these inherited values. Existing lower-slip text, images, numbering, links and executable IDs are retained. Cover/source: [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf]], PDF page 8. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
